other_conditions: Candidates must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) category.
Must have qualified the UGC‑NET‑JRF (Humanities/Social Sciences) or UGC‑CSIR‑NET‑JRF (Science) examinations.
Must be enrolled in a regular full‑time M.Phil. or Ph.D. programme at a university or research institution recognised by the UGC.
Must obtain placement in a University/IIT/Institution for the fellowship.
Employees of any university, college, educational institution or Central/State/UT government are excluded, even if on study or extraordinary leave.
Candidates who are already receiving other central or state government fellowship benefits are not eligible for this fellowship.
Selection is based on merit in the qualifying NET examinations.
The total duration of JRF (2 years) plus possible SRF (up to 3 years) cannot exceed 5 years.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 for the first two years (JRF) and ₹35,000 thereafter (SRF), along with allowances such as contingency, HRA, and assistance for disabled candidates.
